pipelines.name: uav_camera_cpu

pipelines.pipeline: v4l2src device={parameters[device]} ! video/x-raw,width={parameters[camera_width]},height={parameters[camera_height]},framerate={parameters[camera_fps]}/1 ! videoconvert ! video/x-raw,format=NV12 ! tee name=split allow-not-linked=true split. ! queue ! gvadetect device=CPU name=detection model-instance-id={parameters[detection_instance_id]} model={parameters[detection_model]} inference-region=full-frame inference-interval=1 batch-size=1 nireq=2 ie-config="CPU_THROUGHPUT_STREAMS=2" threshold=0.4 ! gvapython module=/home/pipeline-server/gvapython/telemetry-overlay-pymavlink.py class=DrawDynamicText function=process_frame arg=["{parameters[overlay_label]}"] ! queue ! gvametaconvert add-empty-results=true name=metaconvert ! gvametapublish name=destination method=file file-path=/dev/null ! queue ! gvafpscounter ! appsink name=appsink sync=false split. ! queue leaky=downstream max-size-buffers=2 ! videorate drop-only=true ! video/x-raw,framerate=1/5 ! videoscale ! videoconvert ! video/x-raw,format=BGRA,width=[1,{parameters[frame_width]}],height=[1,{parameters[frame_height]}] ! gvagenai name=captioner model-instance-id={parameters[captioner_instance_id]} model-path={parameters[captioner_model_path]} device=CPU prompt="{parameters[captioner_prompt]}" chunk-size=1 generation-config="max_new_tokens={parameters[captioner_max_new_tokens]},num_beams=1,do_sample=false,temperature=0.1,repetition_penalty=1.1" frame-rate=0 metrics=true ! gvametaconvert add-empty-results=true name=caption_metaconvert ! gvapython class=MQTTPublisher function=process module=/home/pipeline-server/gvapython/mqtt_publisher/mqtt_publisher.py name=mqtt_publisher kwarg={% raw %}{{"topic":"{% endraw %}{parameters[mqtt_topic]}{% raw %}"}}{% endraw %} ! fakesink sync=false async=false
